items.title: Launcher 1.0.35 is available
items.body:
## Launcher 1.0.35 changes

- Hunt Damage and Behemoth Parts are now first on the launcher’s Client Mods page, with a Made by Void credit on both cards. This is a normal release and reaches the launcher auto-update feed.
- Restyled the HUD: a rounded translucent damage panel on the left with aligned coloured values and regular-weight labels, and a narrow single-column part list on the right.
- Replaced unsupported text-symbol dots with antialiased glowing image indicators. Parts have thin HP bars: green above half, orange at half or less, red for a confirmed break. Missing or fixed-part data stays gray.
- Uses the game’s RobotoCondensed font, removes the heavy text outline, and clips long part names inside the panel. Removed the part monitor headings, distance line and status-word badges.
- Home → Hunt Damage controls the optional team breakdown. Turn it off for the five-row reference view; existing preferences are preserved. Home → Behemoth Parts controls the part panel.

The HUD mods are optional Windows UE4SS features and remain disabled under Wine/Proton. The Windows and Linux launchers retain the existing Steam Deck startup fixes. Damage totals count combat events received by the client, not an authoritative server scoreboard.

Validation: launcher tests, Lua HUD regressions and release-package integrity checks. Native in-game appearance and the new texture-import path still need a real-hunt smoke test; native game access was unavailable in this session.


---

Dauntless Unbroken Launcher 1.0.35 for Windows and Linux. 

Windows:
- Installer: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-Setup.exe`
- Portable: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.35-win32-x64.zip`

Linux x86_64:
- Universal AppImage: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.35-linux-x86_64.AppImage`
- Debian/Ubuntu/Mint/Pop!_OS: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.35-linux-amd64.deb`
- Fedora/openSUSE/RHEL-family: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.35-linux-x86_64.rpm`
- Portable ZIP: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.35-linux-x64.zip`
- Portable tar.gz: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.35-linux-x64.tar.gz`

Linux runs the pinned Windows game client through an installed Proton or Wine runtime. The launcher
auto-detects Steam Proton, Proton-GE, system Wine and Lutris Wine; no game files are bundled.

- Check your download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or check where it was built with
  `gh attestation verify <file> --repo Vvoidddd/dauntless-unbroken`.

The launcher is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm
(More info, then Run anyway). If Windows only offers "Don't run", check the file's SHA-256
against `SHA256SUMS.txt` from this release (`Get-FileHash <file>` in PowerShell; letter
case does not matter; if they differ, delete the file), then unblock it: right-click the
file > Properties > Unblock, or `Unblock-File <file>` in PowerShell. Installed Windows
launchers update themselves; Linux users update through their package format or a newer release.

Free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0. No game files are included: the launcher downloads
them from your host's server and checks every file against the list built into it.

items.title: Launcher 1.0.34 is available
items.body:
## Launcher 1.0.34 changes

- Fixed native Linux launcher startup when Steam's overlay crashes Electron during Gaming Mode startup. The launcher isolates the overlay before Electron loads and restores the original environment for the game.
- Fixed overlapping Linux update installations. Updates share the existing busy guard; AppImage replacement uses a unique temporary file and keeps the original intact if staging fails.
- Fixed Linux portable relaunch and account-link protocol registration to use the launcher bootstrap.
- Added Steam Deck control setup in Settings → Launcher. Add the native launcher as a non-Steam game, leave forced compatibility off for the launcher, and select a Gamepad layout for that shortcut.

Windows and Linux automated tests and packaged Linux startup checks passed. Physical Steam Deck controller input still needs player confirmation.

items.title: Launcher 1.0.30 is available
items.body:
## Launcher 1.0.30 changes

- Saved accounts for shared PCs: keep multiple player accounts and switch without re-importing keys.
- Open Settings → Account → Saved accounts to import each existing account once. Your current account is saved automatically.
- Use the top-right account menu for quick switching. Close the game before switching; a rejected key leaves the working account selected.
- Keys stay encrypted on this PC. Removing a saved sign-in preserves server progress and exported backups.
- One game installation is shared. Online progress and online playtime follow the selected account; the offline save remains separate.
